comparison.objective: Feed a pinned seam past a sewing needle while removing each pin immediately before it reaches the needle; candidate fractures and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated deformable-seam feeding and sequential pin extraction versus rigid coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, notch fracture, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Advance the seam and remove pins at the required sequence point versus four contact-loaded fractures, all fragments contained, and no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Despite bimanual timing and small-part removal in both, the central abilities differ: sewing-feed coordination versus impact fracture of retained inserts. The body is sparse, supplies no numeric sewing rubric, and has no specs, but it is sufficient to distinguish the objective.
